import ast,copy,json,pathlib,runpy
path=pathlib.Path(r"D:\workspace\AGI的哲学思考\research_cognition_physics\archive_1086_\1088\check.py")
source=path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
env=runpy.run_path(str(path),run_name="review_only")
tree=ast.parse(source)
original=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="simulate")
end=next(i for i,n in enumerate(original.body) if isinstance(n,ast.For))
fn=copy.deepcopy(original)
fn.body=fn.body[:end+1]
fn.body.append(ast.Return(value=ast.Dict(
    keys=[ast.Constant("emissions"),ast.Constant("arrivals"),ast.Constant("active")],
    values=[ast.Name("emissions",ast.Load()),ast.Name("arrivals",ast.Load()),ast.Name("active",ast.Load())])))
fn.name="event_engine_only"
module=ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[fn],type_ignores=[]))
exec(compile(module,"<review_engine_without_postchecks>","exec"),env)
baseline=[env["event_engine_only"](eps) for eps in (0,1)]
class ShiftInitialSeparation(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_Constant(self,node):
        return ast.copy_location(ast.Constant(350),node) if node.value==340 else node
changed=ast.fix_missing_locations(ShiftInitialSeparation().visit(copy.deepcopy(module)))
exec(compile(changed,"<review_engine_initial_distance_350>","exec"),env)
perturbed=[env["event_engine_only"](eps) for eps in (0,1)]
summary=[]
for eps,(before,after) in enumerate(zip(baseline,perturbed)):
    assert not before["active"] and not after["active"]
    assert before["emissions"]==after["emissions"]
    old={e["pulse"]:e for e in before["arrivals"]}
    new={e["pulse"]:e for e in after["arrivals"]}
    assert old.keys()==new.keys() and len(old)==6
    shifts={}
    for pulse,event in old.items():
        shift=new[pulse]["tick"]-event["tick"]
        expected=2 if event["receiver"]=="A" else 5
        assert shift==expected,(pulse,shift)
        shifts[pulse]=shift
    summary.append({"epsilon":eps,"emissions_unchanged":True,
        "arrival_tick_shifts_from_position_change":shifts})
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","method":"In-memory AST retains the authored update loop and removes only post-loop expected-history checks; changes initial spatial separation from 340 to 350. No file writes.","cases":summary},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
